translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Woshumiyaa Mishirati C'imuwaa
Ta na'aw, ta k'aalaa naaga; ta azazuwaakka ne garssan k'osa.
New pas'a de'anaw ta azaziyaawaa ootsa; ta timirttiyaakka ne ayifiyaa buluwaadan naaga.
Hassayissiyaawaadan unttuntta ne birad'd'etuwaan k'achcha; ne wozanaankka s'aafa.
Aad'd'eeda eratetsaa ne michchatidan, akeekaakka ne mata dabbuwaadan s'eella.
Unttunttu neena c'aaratiyaa mishiratippenne bare k'aalan sheleeshshiyaa hara mishiratippe naagana.
Itti gallassi taani ta golliyaa maskkootiyaanna kare s'eellaad;
wozanaa kuntsibeenna wodalla naanatuwaa be'aad. Unttunttu giddoppe ittuu loytsi booza.
He wodallay ogiyaanna biide, itti woshummiyaa mac'c'a mishirati golliyaa mataana aad'd'eedda; I golle afiyaa ogiyaakko pinniide, I golliyaa heeraan hamettee.
He wode sa'ay k'ammanaw lem"ilem"ee.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, mishirata Aa demmaaddu. Iza c'aaratoo gidiyaawaa izi mayuu erissee. Iza asaa c'immanaw k'oppaade kesaaddu.
Iza s'alanne yeellay bayinna mac'c'a asaa; son woppu gaade uttukku.
Iza itti gede ogiyaan, itti gede geyaan, dabaabaa ubbaan ek'k'aade naagaw.
Aa he na'aa k'oommaade yeraaddu; iza Aa ayifiyaa yeelli baynan tishshi ootsa s'eellaade hawaadan yaagaaddu;
«Taani ta yarshshuwaa yarshshaade, ta k'anggetsaa ha"i gatsa simmay.
Yaataade neena s'omoosanaw kesaad; neena loytsa koyaad; ha"i simmi demmaad.
Taani Gibs'eppe yeedda, alleek'k'eedda anssoolaa ta hiis'an yeggaad.
Taani Kawaraa, almmuniyaanne k'arafaa geetettiyaa k'imaamatuwaappe kesseedda shittuwaa ta hiis'an c'ac'c'afaad.
Haaya; ane wonttana gakkanaw siik'uwaa aloytte; k'oomettiidekka nashettoytte;
ayaw gooppe, ta asinay son gidenna; haako sa'aa beedda.
Miishshaa k'arc'c'iitaa kuntsi akkiide beedda diraw, agenay doyssana gakkanaw golle simmenna» yaagaaddu.
Bare mal"o haasayan Aa sheleeshshaaddu; bare liik'o ins's'arssan c'immaaddu.
Yaatina, ellekka I izo kaalliide, bi aggeeda. Booray shukkiyaasaa laagettiyaawaadan, gaaray elleelliide p'iriyaan geliyaawaadan,
tooray Aa wozanaa c'addiyaawaadan haneedda. Dabbaa giddo geleedda kafuwaa malateedda. Hawe ubbay Aa shemppuwaa bayzzanaw haniyaawaa eribeenna.
Ta naanaw, ane ha"i sisite; ta doonaappe kesiyaa k'aalaakka hayzzite.
Ne k'ofay he mac'c'a mishiratina booppo; I ogiyaan gelaade balettoppa.
Aa c'addaade oleeddawanttu unddeneeddawantta; Aa wod'eeddawanttukka loytsi dara.
I soyay duufuwaakko afiyaa ogiyaa; he ogii duge hayk'k'uwaa geessuwaa kaaletsee.
